capabilities: sync the vault live with a remote folder over SSH/SFTP
resolve simultaneous edits with last-writer-wins and report remote deletions
protect a device from deletions with a per-device permanent-save switch
relay encrypted SSH traffic through a WebSocket for Android devices
exclude paths and prepare devices with a local config file
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian community store and not reviewed by Obsidian staff; it is installed via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases, which is where the docs live.
problem: Obsidian's built-in sync relies on a paid cloud service; self-hosters want to sync their vault across devices through their own SSH server without any third party.

requires.name: an SSH server (OpenSSH) on an always-on machine, plus a small Python relay for phones

summary: Live two-way vault sync with a folder on your own server over SSH/SFTP, with conflict handling, deletion protection and Android support via a relay.
